title: Model-Free Assessment of Simulator Fidelity via Quantile Curves
benchmark_measurement: Alignment of LLM-generated survey responses with human populations, where 'Religious affiliation' was one of the demographic variables used to construct synthetic user profiles from the World Values Survey.
findings: The paper's findings focus on a general framework for evaluating the fidelity of LLMs in simulating human survey responses across various demographics, including religion. It ranks models based on their overall alignment, finding that GPT-4O showed the most reliable alignment on the WorldValueBench dataset. However, the paper does not provide specific findings or analyses related to how models perform on questions or user profiles involving religion.
